shellCommands.command: npm start >/tmp/next-start.log 2>&1 & sleep 3 && curl -s http://localhost:3000/ | grep -o 'href="/catalog[^"]*"'

for i in 1 2; do /usr/bin/time -f "cold=%2es" true 2>/dev/null; s=$(date +%s%N); curl -s -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" -o /tmp/sale-$i.rsc; e=$(date +%s%N); echo "sale request $i: $(( (e-s)/1000000 ))ms"; done; grep -c "Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug" /tmp/sale-1.rsc /tmp/sale-2.rsc

curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=sale" | grep -o "Products on sale\|Canvas Tote\|Travel Mug\|Loading category" | sort | uniq -c; echo ===; curl -sL -H "RSC: 1" "http://localhost:3000/catalog?category=featured" | grep -o "Featured products\|Desk Lamp\|Wool Blanket\|Products on sale" | sort | uniq -c; echo ===; ls /workspace/.next/server/app/catalog* 2>/dev/null; ls /workspace/.next/prerender-manifest.json >/dev/null && node -e "const m=require('/workspace/.next/prerender-manifest.json'); console.log(JSON.stringify(Object.keys(m.routes||{})))"
find /workspace/.next/server/app/catalog.segments -name "*.segment.rsc" | head; echo ===; grep -rl "Canvas Tote" /workspace/.next/server 2>/dev/null | head -5
pkill -f "next-server\|next start" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:3000/ >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
pkill -f "next start" 2>/dev/null; pkill -f "next/dist/bin" 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:3000/ >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"

ps aux | grep -i next | grep -v grep; (command -v fuser >/dev/null && fuser -k 3000/tcp) || kill $(ps aux | awk '/next|node.*start/ && !/grep|awk/ {print $2}' | head -5) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; curl -s -m 2 http://localhost:3000/ >/dev/null && echo "still up" || echo "stopped"
